region.hintSelected: Region {rect} selected — the AI redraws the full image following this region

prompt.label: Instruction
prompt.desc: State what to change and what to keep for stable results
prompt.placeholder: e.g. Place the person from image 2 into the living room of image 1, keep the face and body consistent, match lighting and perspective
prompt.fusion: Place the person from image 2 naturally into the scene of image 1, keeping facial features and body proportions consistent, with lighting, color and perspective matched to image 1.
prompt.outfit: Keep the person in image 1 unchanged and dress them in the outfit from image 2, with natural folds and lighting.
prompt.style: Keep the content, composition and person of image 1 unchanged, but shift the overall style to a cinematic look with richer lighting and color.
prompt.cleanup: Remove clutter and extra people from image 1, fill in the occluded background and keep the scene coherent.
prompt.enhance: Increase sharpness and detail of image 1, fix blur and noise while keeping the person unchanged.
prompt.twoImagesPrefix: Image 1 is the base image, image 2 is the reference material.
prompt.multiImagesPrefix: Image 1 is the base image, images {from}-{to} are reference materials.
prompt.regionMarked: The red rectangle in image 1 marks the region to edit. Apply the following instruction to that region and blend the result naturally with the surrounding lighting, color and perspective. The red box only indicates the location and must not appear in the output.
